translations.web: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
translations.bsb: He who trusts in himself is a fool, but one who walks in wisdom will be safe.
translations.kjv: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
translations.asv: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool; But whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
